entities.name: Query legumain
observations: 433 aa protein; predicted molecular mass 49.24 kDa and theoretical pI 5.94.
N-terminal residues 1–17 are strongly consistent with a cleavable secretory signal peptide.
Has Peptidase_C13 domain at residues 29–285 and Legum_prodom domain at residues 334–429.
Matches reviewed mammalian legumain homologs at 80.4–81.3% identity over 100% of the sequence.
Homology supports cysteine-type asparaginyl endopeptidase activity, with slower cleavage of aspartyl bonds under acidic conditions.
Reference legumain proteins have catalytic active-site positions corresponding to Asp148 and Cys189, with autocatalytic cleavage near residue 323/324.
Reference proteins localize mainly to lysosomes/endolysosome lumen; extracellular and exosome-associated localization is also reported for human legumain.
Likely synthesized as a zymogen: signal peptide followed by catalytic mature chain and a C-terminal inhibitory/propeptide region that is removed by autocatalysis.
